QuestInfo.name: The Kerning City Book Store Owner 1
QuestInfo.0: Ask Mr. Pickall about Jeppi, the owner of the Kerning City book store.
QuestInfo.1: Mr. Pickall won't let you have the information for free. Eliminate #rEvil Eyes#k in #bEllinia#k and get #b70 Evil Eye Tails#k. Surely he knows something...\r\n
QuestInfo.2: Once he had the Evil Eye Tails safely put away, Mr. Pickall told you that Jeppi moved to Ellinia. He did it in such a hurry, he didn't even take all of his belongings with him...

0.0: Well, yes, yes, of course I knew where Jeppi went. And I can tell you, oh yes, I can. And you want to know WHY I'm going to tell you? Because you're going to go to the #bEllinia#k and bring me #b70 Evil Eye Tails#k off the #rEvil Eyes#k there!
0.1: Where am I going to use these Evil Eye Tails? Why would I tell you? It's very personal. Just go get them.

yes.0: Use that #bEllinia Return Scroll#k I just gave you to go right quick. I hear there's a lot of Evil Eyes in the #m101030000#. Now shoo.

no.0: Are you having trouble understanding the words coming out of my mouth?

1.0: Excellent, the Evil Eye Tails! Now, move along, move along. Oh, right. Jeppi. He moved to #bEllinia#k in a big hurry. He left most of his stuff behind. You know the rule: finders keepers, so don't even think about it. I already claimed it all.
1.1: Anyway, he doesn't live in Ellinia proper, but near some #bGiant Tree#k nearby. I wouldn't go so far as to call him a friend, but he adores me, so I keep in touch.
1.2: Hm? So, you just got back from the Giant Tree. I guess there's hope for you yet.

yes.0: You need to go to Ellinia to see Jeppi. Go see Ryden, she's looking for you.

item.0: Where are my #b70 Evil Eye Tails#k?!
